text: 🇲🇽✊ "Health is a human right." Colima gets 198 new primary-care clinics — all free. "Todo gratuito, obviamente, porque la salud es un derecho humano." "All free, obviously, because health is a human right." — Claudia Sheinbaum, "Honestidad y resultados", Colima, Sept 5 2026 The 198 community clinics open by January 2027 — each with a doctor, equipment and 60 basic medicines — plus a new IMSS-Bienestar general hospital in Manzanillo. Across Colima, 245,365 people now receive a Bienestar program: 92,288 pensions for the elderly, 22,000 women on Pensión Mujeres Bienestar, and 20,700 new homes announced.

🇲🇽📈 <u>Banxico Raises Mexico's 2026 Growth Forecast</u>

Banxico lifted its 2026 growth forecast to 1.5% from 1.1%, after the economy outran expectations in the second quarter — the new range runs 1.0–2.0%, with 2027 held at 2.0%. The upgrade comes even with Trump's tariffs and the T-MEC review still hanging over the outlook.

🇲🇽🏳️‍🌈 <u>INE Refuses to Pull Its Diversity Campaign</u>

Mexico's electoral authority stood its ground after a wave of online attacks on its video inviting Indigenous and LGBTQ+ youth into civic life. "The presence of persons with these characteristics is not a privilege," the INE said, urging critics to "eradicate hatred and intolerance": "Criticism must not translate into aggression, threats, or discriminatory expression."

🛢️🇲🇽 <u>Pemex Signs Deepwater Know-How Deal</u>

Pemex signed a non-binding memorandum with Australia's Woodside to swap technical expertise on deepwater exploration — including the Trion frontier, some 2,500 meters down in the Gulf. No assets ceded, no binding commitment: CEO Juan Carlos Carpio and Woodside's Liz Westcott cast it as capacity-building, state engineers absorbing the deepwater know-how Mexico needs to work its own reserves.

🇲🇽🚺 <u>Mexico City Puts Care Work on the Books</u>

In Mexico City, women average 41 hours a week of unpaid care work — 50 in the poorest households, against 14 for men. Mayor Clara Brugada just installed a Junta de Cuidados to shift that load: 300 free public childcare centers (6:30am–6pm, within 15 minutes of any home), support for 151,000 children under 3, and direct cash for 5,000 caregivers. The stated goal — de-feminize, de-familiarize, and de-commodify care.

🚨🇲🇽 <u>"Not a Pretext for an Invasion" — Sheinbaum to Washington</u>

Sheinbaum drew the line on Washington's push to brand Mexican cartels "foreign terrorists": "The fight against organized crime must not be a pretext for an invasion." She invoked Article 40 of the Constitution — now hardened to bar any foreign intervention — and rejected the label itself: "We can't accept calling these groups terrorists; their objective is different — that doesn't mean they aren't criminal groups."

🇲🇽🛢️ <u>Pemex Oil Workers Win 7.5% Raise</u>

Pemex and the STPRM oil-workers union sealed a 7.5% integral pay raise for the 2026-2027 review — 5.5% straight to wages, retroactive to Aug 1, an 8.7% bump to the food basket (6,064 → 6,592 pesos), and roughly 7,000 temporary workers made permanent. 35 of the union's 36 sections voted yes.
